cases.brief: A Ninel pilot has a validated production package but incomplete media evidence.
observables: Uses edit-first order, then sound, music, VFX, color, titles/captions, and mastering/QC last.
Preserves planned and evidence states, invents no approvals, runs validate-post, and returns planned rather than false readiness.

cases.brief: A documentary post package contains an invalid edit dependency and later downstream records.
observables: Repairs the earliest invalid dependency, invalidates only its downstream closure, preserves valid unaffected records, and reruns validate-post.
Returns blocked while unresolved evidence remains; never promotes an old approval to ready-for-master-review.
